metadata.case_name: WONG KAM MAN AND OTHERS v. WONG KAM CHUEN

source: Agreed medical evidence discloses that Plaintiff had a concussion, a period of post-traumatic amnesia, dizziness, a compound fracture of the right humerus (bone of upper arm) and a fracture of right tibia and fibula (bones of the lower leg).
injuries.icd_description: Concussion with incomplete loss of consciousness with amnesia

injuries.description: a compound fracture of the right humerus (bone of upper arm)
source: a compound fracture of the right humerus (bone of upper arm)
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of shoulder or upper arm, unspecified

injuries.description: a fracture of right tibia and fibula (bones of the lower leg)
source: a fracture of right tibia and fibula (bones of the lower leg)
The broken limbs were in plaster and the fractured tibia was also secured with a bone plate and screw which were later removed.

manifestations.description: suffered a blackout and only regained conciousness some 5 days later in a hospital bed
sporadic spells of dizziness, particularly after long working hours
Plaintiff at first walked with crutches, then with a stick and could finally do without them

treatments_received: fractured tibia was secured with a bone plate and screw
removal of bone plate and screw a few months later
use of crutches and walking stick

losses.description: Plaintiff at first walked with crutches, then with a stick and could finally do without them.
Plaintiff still complains of having sporadic spells of dizziness, particularly after long working hours.
